papers.title: Behavioral Compositionality of Sparse Autoencoder Representations
papers.abstract: Tests whether sparse autoencoder features act additively on model behavior. Learned coordinates compose better than random rotations, yet pairwise interaction terms still improve predictions.

papers.title: Virtual Head Attention
papers.abstract: Proposes an attention variant that cuts KV cache size and training/prefill compute using two lightweight linear operations, while matching or exceeding GQA quality at several model scales.

papers.title: EDEN: Embedding-Space Directional Exploration with Anchored Noise for LLM RLVR
papers.abstract: Improves exploration in reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards by perturbing a prompt's input embedding with anchored noise, boosting solution diversity without changing inference.

papers.title: LEASH: Uncertainty-Aware Weak-to-Strong Escalation and Oversight for Computer-Use Agents
papers.abstract: Routes computer-use tasks from a small agent to a strong one only when the small agent's hidden-state uncertainty is high, then monitors the strong agent, cutting cost with similar success.

papers.title: Mine, Sample, Render: Test-Time Diversity Alignment Of Generative Models
papers.abstract: Mines a categorical schema from real artifacts, samples attribute configurations from corpus statistics, and uses a generative model only to render them, improving diversity and corpus alignment.

papers.title: Gen4P: Video Generators are 4D Perceivers
papers.abstract: Repurposes a pretrained video generator into a single-pass 4D perceiver that recovers geometry and motion from monocular video using on-demand cross-attention queries and a frozen depth prior.

papers.title: Scalable Weak-to-Strong Verifier Hardening for Agent Environments
papers.abstract: Automatically hardens agent-environment verifiers against reward hacking using an isolated sandbox and an iterative hacker-fixer loop, substantially reducing attack success on several benchmarks.

papers.title: LeanPRM: Lean-Grounded Process Supervision for Natural Language Proof Verification
papers.abstract: Uses the Lean proof assistant to label each step of natural-language proofs automatically, producing step-level training data for verifiers without human annotation.

papers.title: Copy-Paste Language Models
papers.abstract: Adds a lightweight copy head alongside the standard language modeling head, improving training efficiency, downstream results, and long-context retrieval with minimal overhead.

papers.title: PathFM: Fast Generative Forecasting of Multivariate Trajectories
papers.abstract: Uses flow matching to generate full future trajectories for time series, distilled to one or two sampling steps, to better model dependence structure than marginal quantile forecasters.

cc_updates.body:
* Added `CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_MODE_MODEL` to choose the model the client-side auto mode classifier uses; it does not change the model for server-side auto mode
* Added an `Idle compaction` row to `/config` for turning idle compaction off or back on; the notices shown after an idle compaction now say how to turn it off
* Added a notice to `/design-sync` and `/design-login` that standalone Claude Design (claude.ai/design) closes by December 14, 2026
* Fixed a "Prompt is too long" error when stopping a turn while the conversation was being compacted
* Fixed requests failing with diagnostics extra inputs error

* Added `CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG_MAX_USAGE_LIMIT_WAIT_MS` so unattended retry mode ends a request at a usage limit that resets too far away instead of waiting
* Added OpenTelemetry tracing guidance to the `claude-api` skill, including setting up trace destinations with the `ant` CLI
* Added the `%` motion to vim mode: jump to the matching bracket, alone or with d/c/y
* Added `rows` to a mod's `Input`: a text field of several lines in the terminal, where Enter submits and Shift+Enter or a backslash before Enter starts a new line

* Added `virtualText` to a mod's prompt decorations: text drawn in the prompt box that never enters the draft or the submitted prompt
* Added `cache_creation_5m_tokens` and `cache_creation_1h_tokens` to the OpenTelemetry `api_request` event, splitting cache writes by lifetime
* Added `$.ui.view({ agentId })` for mods: shows an agent's transcript in the main view when you ask, and `$.ui.view({})` goes back
* Added a `dir` prop on a mod's `Text` for right-to-left text
